about_the_game:
An Adventure that Spins the Wheel of Fortune！

"Arcana Famiglia -La storia della Arcana Famiglia- Ancora", a game based on the concept of a Otome game × Shonen manga, originally available on the in 2015, will be ported to the Steam!

This is a story of destiny and bonds centered around Felicita, the daughter of the boss of Arcana Famiglia, an organization on a small island that possesses mysterious powers.

The game progresses with a comic-like storyline that uses colorful illustrations called the Comiaru system. The game also features the unique Cocoaru System, which allows you to read the minds of other characters!

Enjoy character designer and original artist Sara Chiyomi's beautiful CG illustrations in full HD quality!

The story is brought to life by a talented cast of voice actors including Jun Fukuyama, Tsubasa Yonaga, Hiroyuki Yoshino, Tomokazu Sugita, Yuichi Nakamura, Jurota Kosugi, and Koji Yusa!

STORY

Acrana Famiglia is an autonomous organization that protects the small island of Regalo in the Mediterranean Sea.

Those who belong to the Famiglia have a mysterious power called Arcana, which they use to protect the island from outside enenmies.

Felicita (main character/name can be changed), the only daughter of the organization's boss Mondo, has only just taken her first steps as a member of the family.

April 1st. It's Mondo's birthday. At a party thrown for him by the family, he makes a surprising announcement.

Mondo: "Two months from now...June 1. We'll hold the Arcana Duello!"

Mondo: "The winner of the Duello will become the leader of the organization...and as the new Papa, they will wed my daughter."

This is Felicita's story, as she fights to win the Arcana Duello in order to change her own destiny.

Felicita: "My path...is for me to decide."

KEYWORD

Arcana Famiglia

The vigilante-like organization that the protagonist belongs to. Her father, Mondo, is the boss of the organiation, and is referred to as Papa. His wife Sumire is also referred to as Mama.

Within the family, there are members who gain special abilities called Arcana by forming a contract with Tarocco.

The organization is divided into an intelligence department that also handles diplomacy, and four departments that maintain public order on the island, and sometimes work with the island's lord to take charge of self-governance and security on Regalo Island.

In each Serie (department), there are people with titles such as "King", "Queen", "Knight", and "Page", each with around 10 subordinates who support their respective executives."

Arcana Abilities

Making a contract with the Tarocco, a card that holds mysterious power, can grant abilities known as Arcana.

Currently, no new contracts are being made for the 22 cards that comprise the Major Arcana.

Those who make contracts with the Major Arcana are also called hosts, and make a mark (Stigmata) engraved somewhere on their body as proof of the contract.

Almost all of the other family members have physical abilities that are greater than those of an ordinary person, thanks to simple contracts formed with the Minor Arcana.

Tarocco

A mysterious card deck that was unsealed by Mondo.

Through Mondo's contract with The World card, it protects the peace of the island of Regalo from outside threats.

Though it grants abilities that normal people do not possess, it seems there is also a price to pay for those abilities.

content_descriptors.notes: Some scenes in the game contain content suggesting sexual acts such as kissing and hugging, depictions of violence.
